title: C-O4 fix round 2: redact start() refusal reasons, bound the body before buffering, guard repos.toml parsing and per-repo fan-out, idempotent cancel (from review T-0155)
spec:
Fix round for T-0153 (branch task/T-0153 at 38db9bb, on top of T-0147 be42500). Work in this task's worktree, cut from task/T-0153. Review T-0155 (opus) requested changes; items come from it. Do not widen scope.

1 MED serve.py 422 path (≈line 156): goals.start refusal reasons can embed git stderr (f"git add failed: {stderr}", "scaffold commit failed: ...", "GOAL task creation failed (rc=...): ..."). Before any reason string goes into a JSONResponse, pass it through the existing CREDENTIAL_RE redaction and cap it at 300 chars; log the full text to the server log (redacted as well). Apply the same helper to every place a goals.* string reaches a body (422 reasons, cancel errors). Test: start returns launched false with reason containing "https://u:SECRET@h/r.git" → 422 body has no "SECRET" and contains "***".

2 MED serve.py body bound (≈line 106): enforce MAX_BODY_BYTES before buffering: if the Content-Length header is present and > MAX_BODY_BYTES → 413 without reading; otherwise read via `request.stream()` accumulating chunks and abort with 413 as soon as the total exceeds MAX_BODY_BYTES (never call request.body() on POST /goals). Test: a request with Content-Length 40000000 and a short body → 413 without reading the stream (patch the stream to assert it was not consumed); a chunked body over the limit → 413 with at most MAX_BODY_BYTES + one chunk consumed.

3 LOW serve.py repos.toml (≈line 50): wrap tomllib.loads (and the file read) in try/except → 503 {"reason": "repos.toml unreadable"} with the parse error logged; /healthz unchanged. In the unfiltered GET /goals fan-out (≈line 176), isolate each slug: an exception from goals.list_goals for one repo becomes an entry {"repo": slug, "error": "unreadable"} and the others still return. Tests for both.

4 LOW serve.py cancel (≈line 213): wrap the goals.stop call in try/except (ProcessLookupError, PermissionError) → 200 {goal_id, repo, status: "stopped", note: "planner already gone"}. Test with goals.stop patched to raise ProcessLookupError → 200.

No new dependency. Commit on the task branch when green. Finish with: summary, files changed, failures-only test output.
acceptance: No goals.* string reaches a response body unredacted; the SECRET test passes; full text goes to the log
Content-Length above MAX_BODY_BYTES yields 413 without reading; streamed bodies abort at the limit (tests)
Malformed repos.toml yields 503 on goal routes with /healthz still 200; one failing repo in the fan-out does not break the others (tests)
Cancel returns 200 stopped when the planner is already gone (test)
uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests green; no new dependency; only serve.py and tests/test_serve.py change; committed on the task branch

result.summary:
All 191 tests pass (`OK`). The one "Traceback" line in the grep is expected diagnostic output from the `access_log.error(..., exc_info=True)` call in the fan-out isolation test — not a failure.

## Summary

Implemented all four T-0155 review items in `orchestrator/serve.py`, adding matching tests in `tests/test_serve.py`.

1. **Reason redaction/cap**: added `_safe_reason()` — applies `CREDENTIAL_RE`, caps the client-facing string at 300 chars, logs the full redacted text via `access_log`. Wired into the `goals.start` 422 path.
2. **Body bound**: added `_read_body_bounded()` — checks `Content-Length` and rejects with `None` before touching the stream if it's over `MAX_BODY_BYTES`; otherwise reads via `request.stream()`, aborting as soon as the running total exceeds the limit. `create_goal` never calls `request.body()` anymore.
3. **repos.toml robustness**: added `_load_repos_or_503()`, used by `_resolve_repo` and the unfiltered `list_all_goals` fan-out; a parse/read failure now yields `503 {"reason": "repos.toml unreadable"}` (logged), `/healthz` untouched. The unfiltered fan-out loop now isolates each repo's `goals.list_goals` call in try/except, appending `{"repo": slug, "error": "unreadable"}` on failure instead of aborting the whole response.
4. **Cancel resilience**: `cancel_goal` wraps `goals.stop` in try/except for `ProcessLookupError`/`PermissionError`, returning `200 {..., "note": "planner already gone"}`.

**Files changed**: `orchestrator/serve.py`, `tests/test_serve.py` (only in-scope paths).

**Test run**: `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` → 191 tests, `OK`, no failures.

Committed on `task/T-0158` as `6f8018d`.
